canonical_project: LMS Energy modular bioenergy-powered data storage facility, Werribee RDF
notes: Star Weekly reported a planning permit application for a $3m modular data centre at the Werribee tip, to be powered by LMS Energy's landfill-gas generation. Wyndham RDF community reference group minutes in 2022 note a visit to the newly established data storage facility adjacent to the LMS gas recovery/energy generation plant.
